subject: Subprocessor attestation and onshore fallback for PSC integration
messages:
From: Natalie Brooks <natalie.brooks@psc-inc.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: subprocessor attestation + payment proxy details
Attachments: PSC_DPA_QA_Form.pdf (form)

Hi Sergio,

We're moving PSC Inc's integration into the final procurement review and our legal/compliance teams need an up-to-date subprocessor roster and a couple clarifications before we can sign the DPA addendum. Can you please provide the following by EOD Thursday if possible: 

- Current subprocessor list (names, country of processing, role)
- Which payment processor(s) act as subprocessors for tokenized billing or card data proxying? Are any of those vendors passing data outside the US?
- Do you provide onshore fallback for logs/telemetry for EU customers (i.e., routing to EU-only processors) as part of the integration? If so, please describe the mechanism and provide evidence or a short attestation.
- KMS/HSM scope: do you share keys with any third parties, or do customers bring their own keys?

I've attached PSC_DPA_QA_Form.pdf with the specific fields our GRC team expects filled. Also looping in our procurement lead Ethan Wallace (cc'ed on our side) who will track timing.

Thanks — we want to keep this moving.

Best,
Natalie Brooks
Director, Platform Integrations
PSC Inc

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Brooks <natalie.brooks@psc-inc.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor attestation + payment proxy details
Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_roster.csv

Natalie —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick recap and the files attached to start: I've attached our latest redwood_subprocessor_roster.csv (export of the vendor roster with roles and processing countries). A few highlights inline below to help your GRC team triage: 

- Payments / tokenization: Payflow Solutions (US) acts as our payment proxy for billing tokens. Payflow stores a minimal payment token and does not receive PII beyond billing metadata. Payflow has a US processing footprint; no payment-related data is routed to non-US datacenters by default.

- Observability/telemetry: We use StreamSight (EU/US) and EdgeTrace (US) depending on region. For EU customers that opt for data residency, we can enable an onshore fallback that routes telemetry and snapshots to our EU-only StreamSight tenancy. That configuration is customer-configurable at contract signing and enforced by our routing policy (we can provide a config snapshot).

- KMS and keys: We offer both Redwood-managed KMS (AWS KMS with customer-specific CMKs) and a BYOK/HSM option for enterprise customers. We do not share customer CMKs across tenants; where a customer requests an HSM-backed BYOK, the key material is managed by the customer's KMS/HSM and only wrapped keys are stored by Redwood.

Next steps I propose:
1) Our roster csv attached for immediate review.
2) Kim (security) will provide the SOC2 snapshot and KMS attestation PDFs.
3) If PSC needs a signed attestation template, we can sign the DPA addendum or provide a short letter on Redwood letterhead.

Let me know if you want to set a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the roster with your GRC team.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: redwood_subprocessor_roster.csv (csv with vendor, role, country columns)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Brooks <natalie.brooks@psc-inc.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor attestation + payment proxy details
Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2025.pdf, kms-attestation.pdf

Hi Natalie —

Thanks for the ping and Sergio for the roster. A few technical clarifications from the security team that will help PSC's GRC sign off: 

- SOC 2 / evidence: attached is a current SOC2 snapshot (scope: production inference and orchestration). If you require the full report we can initiate our secure-share process with your legal team.

- KMS/KI: attached kms-attestation.pdf outlines our BYOK flow and the fact that customer CMKs are not exported from customer HSMs. For Redwood-managed KMS we use per-customer CMKs (not shared).

- Onshore fallback mechanics: the routing policy for telemetry is implemented at the edge-router layer and is enforced via policy tags on tenant traffic. For EU residency we can provide a short network flow diagram and a sample routing-policy export — happy to include that in a separate zip if helpful.

- Payment proxy scope: note that while Payflow handles tokenized billing metadata, PSC should still run its PCI questionnaire for your payment flows; Payflow retains its own PCI attestation which we can share under an NDA.

If PSC needs a signed attestation (on letterhead) confirming the onshore fallback configuration and KMS posture, we can produce that within 2 business days once you confirm the exact wording you want.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Engineer, Cloud & Privacy
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: SOC2-snapshot-2025.pdf, kms-attestation.pdf

Sergio / Kim —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple items before we can finalize: 

- Please confirm in writing (signed letter or DocuSign) that the redwood_subprocessor_roster.csv reflects all subprocessors used in the PSC integration and that Redwood will notify PSC within 30 days of any additions that may materially affect data residency.
- Provide the network flow diagram or routing-policy export you mentioned for the EU onshore fallback.
- Share Payflow's PCI attestation under NDA; we will confirm whether PSC requires Payflow to sign any additional data processing commitments.

Once we have the signed attestation and the routing export, we should be able to complete our internal GRC checklist and move to countersignature. Please send the DocuSign link (or attach the PDF for signature) — I've copied Ethan Wallace from procurement to coordinate timing.

Thanks,
PSC Legal
legal@psc-inc.com
